name: Surface inventory and global mass-conservation accounting
purpose: Close synchronized Na and Ar particle and mass budgets across adsorption, desorption, inventory change, escape, physical sinks, and numerical loss.
production_capability: Surface inventory and global mass-conservation accounting
configuration: Dedicated Na,Ar build; photolytic chemistry generated OFF; uniform continuous 3.8e20 atoms s^-1 Ar M2 driver; eight MPI ranks; no inferred constants.
independent_reference: Exact signed atom/mass conservation identity evaluated over synchronized windows; adsorption/desorption cancel as internal transfers.
units: atoms, atoms s^-1, kg, and kg s^-1; synchronized simulation seconds
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed geometry, LSO particle state, SPICE TDB internally, archive UTC where supplied
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Random seed and MPI/OpenMP layout recorded; stochastic criteria use declared confidence intervals.
procedure: Verify I13 and generated chemistry-OFF contract; synchronize Na/Ar accounting windows; reduce weighted production counters over MPI; write every signed term; independently recompute particle and mass closure.
acceptance_criteria: Converted-in and converted-out exactly zero; deterministic accounting closes to machine precision; full Monte Carlo imbalance <0.5% of dominant source; no physical sink is combined with numerical loss.
expected_pass_result: The declared linked M2 capability is evaluated and every frozen criterion is met.
data_hashes: Recorded in run_manifest.json after package hash verification.
status_semantics: PASS means the full linked criterion ran and passed; FAIL means it ran and missed the criterion; ERROR is infrastructure/parser/corruption; SKIPPED means a prerequisite, capability, configuration, or authoritative input is unavailable.
